title: Tighten the listing continuation basis: one scan, cut fields only for next, and a ProjectCut boundary test
outcome: Tighten the listing continuation basis: one scan, cut fields only for next, and a ProjectCut boundary test
acceptance: a membership-basis listing token carries only the observed time beside its fingerprint; project_position and valid_until_ms live only in the project-cut basis that compact next mints, and catalog_cut's project-wide expiry query runs only for that basis
a test shows a compact-next-minted ready continuation is refused by a note on an unrelated item and inside the boundary millisecond of a sub-millisecond claim expiry

an ls page evaluates the classified catalog CTE at most twice: total, preceding and anchor come from the ordered membership pass, which streams rows into the fingerprint rather than building one string (test or measured count of catalog queries)

completion.summary: Landed 501127f: ls continuation tokens carry only observed_at and the membership fingerprint; the project cut (position, observed time, expiry) lives only in compact next's ProjectCut basis, and ls checks read no project-wide expiry. One streaming membership pass yields fingerprint, total, preceding and anchor; an ls page runs the classified catalog query twice. Tests in listing/basis.rs cover the unrelated-note refusal, the sub-millisecond boundary, the query counts and the fingerprint bytes. Readiness ready on all 4 stores; installed build 797ac9c27cf6, exe sha256 a01bb029…7b9.
